Appraiser remarks
The vehicle shows crush and paint transfer along the driver side rear quarter panel,
consistent with the side impact at the intersection, and the damage pattern lines up
with the account given. Structural measurements are within tolerance and no prior
damage is recorded on this vehicle. The estimate, however, lists repair labor at
roughly three times what this extent of damage would normally require, and the shop's
own invoice history shows the same service billed twice on one date, which the provider
has acknowledged was a repeat charge. Recommend the labor hours be reviewed line by
line, the duplicate charge removed, and the panel replacement scope confirmed before
approval. Repairs can proceed on the front bumper once the revised figures are
returned.

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
